summary: 1470 Owens Street is a parking structure at Mission Bay, designed by Watry Design to serve multiple UCSF life-science buildings and the adjacent Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices. DataSF Assessor records and Watry Design's own project page both date its completion to 2020.

DBI permit #201806010826 for the parking garage reached 'complete' status.

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2020 completion is not sourced, only the year.

A WRNS Studio project page titled 'UCSF Parking Structure' (wrnsstudio.com/projects/ucsf-parking-structure/) lists a completion of 2012 and describes a 10-story, 627-stall, 223,602 sq ft structure that it calls the 'Owens Street Parking Structure', without giving a street number. Watry Design's page for 1470 Owens lists completion 2020, 4 levels, 317 stalls and 109,200 sq ft, and the Assessor's year built for this parcel is also 2020, so the WRNS page is treated here as describing a different, earlier building, not this parcel. Which building the WRNS page depicts is not confirmed.

As of 2026-09-29, no source found dates the start of physical construction; the timeline carries the permit issue date (2018-10-03) and completion (2020) only. Watry Design's page lists its owner as 'Developer', so no source read names UCSF as the garage's owner.

WRNS Studio was earlier named as the designer; the only cited designer page (Watry Design) names Watry, and the WRNS 'UCSF Parking Structure' page has not been confirmed to be this garage, so WRNS is not stated here.
